features.statement: A single system UI font stack is used throughout, with no web fonts loaded.
Heading outline skips levels, jumping from H1 straight to H4 for card titles before any H2.
Grouped listings use nested heading hierarchy, with group headings as H3 and individual item headings as H4.
A single saturated orange-red accent color is used for buttons, links, underlines and badges.
Deep navy is used for headings and navigation link text, matching a navy section band.
Footer uses light blue-gray text on a navy background.
Page background is a pale cool gray with dark slate body text.
A thin dark utility bar above the main header holds secondary links and a compact select-plus-button finder.
White header has logo left, right-aligned nav links, and the active link marked by an orange underline.
Hero is a full-bleed darkened, blurred photo with centered white heading text on top.
Feature cards sit in a four-column row with top photos and uneven text lengths leaving unequal bottoms.
Content is constrained to a centered container about 1140px wide with wide side margins.
Every card uses the same repeated stock photo, and small source images are upscaled to larger display sizes.
Photos have empty alt attributes while logos carry descriptive alt text.
A full-width colored band presents a logo above a centered, bold, multi-line white statement.
Section intro has centered heading, muted subtitle and a row of pill-shaped filter chips.
Group headings are left-aligned with a short accent-colored underline rule.
Card grid has four columns, leaving empty columns when a group has fewer items.
Pill-shaped accent badges such as 'COMING SOON!' overlay the top-left corner of card images.
Some cards have empty bodies, lacking description text or link, leaving blank space.
Copy is short, upbeat marketing text with frequent exclamation marks.
Descriptions include concrete numeric facts such as square footage figures.
Footer bottom bar is split by a thin divider, with copyright and legal links left and credit right.
Cards have white bodies, thin borders and rounded corners, with the link pinned to the card bottom.
Visual effects are minimal: few shadows and transitions, with no gradients, animations, blur or transforms.
Styling comes from one inline style block with a few custom class names, not utility classes.
Layout relies mainly on flexbox with a few grid containers.
Text-link calls to action are bold accent-colored text ending in an arrow glyph, not buttons.
No emoji or em dashes appear in the text.
Newsletter and finder use simple forms with a single input or select each.
Brand logo appears repeatedly in header, mid-page band and footer.
